title: V1B — First bridgeV002 Pilot: connect model-allocator to bridgeV002 on one non-critical role (imple01, strict_review), direct_* path unchanged, no frontend (V3)
design_notes:
Handoff 66 implements V1B (scope docs/governance-templates-v2/11_SCOPE.md §16.2 in model-allocator repo). CROSS-REPO: model-allocator + Father. V1A (handoff 65) proved alias resolution+validation (committed model-allocator 48ed685, pushed). V1B connects the allocator to bridgeV002 on ONE pilot role, direct_* path untouched.

CRITICAL INVARIANT (Human): bridgeV002 must keep running in current form. V1B interpretation: all existing roles run unchanged via direct_*; only the pilot opts in; start_coding.py/dispatch.py changes strictly conditional on model_source=='model_allocator'; command_builder.py + direct_* semantics UNCHANGED; pilot reversible (set model_source back to NULL).

Five Architect decisions baked into handoff 66 <context> (resolving scope §20 items 4,5,6,7 + run/stop contract):
1. client = existing bridge_roles.default_runtime column (NO new client column). Allocator --client populated from default_runtime. [§20 item 4]
2. Pilot = imple01 (strict_review): default_runtime=opencode, default_provider=local_ollama, default_model=qwen3-coder:30b-256k, config_dir=imple01. Chosen: Ollama+OpenCode matches V1B adapter set; on-demand dev flow (non-critical, not cron); reversible. Maps to NEW alias imple01-local (real_model qwen3-coder:30b-256k, runtime_profile local_ollama_cuda0, lifecycle stop_after_step, clients.opencode=true). [§20 item 6]
3. OpenCode client adapter first (Claude Code = V2; trade roles use default_runtime=claude). [§20 item 7]
4. run contract: `model-allocator run --role <role> --client opencode` prints tmux-safe shell string to stdout; start_coding.py captures + prepends cd + sends via existing run_cmd_in_session. Allocator does NOT own tmux. OpenCode adapter must be equivalent to command_builder.build_opencode_ollama_command (argv [opencode, --model, ollama/<real_model>], env OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR+OPENCODE_CONFIG from config_dir). [§20 item 5 run-half]
5. stop contract: `model-allocator stop --alias` runs ollama stop with INTERNAL timeout (must NOT inherit dispatch.py post-dispatch hang); dispatch.py calls it with OUTER timeout when role is allocator-enabled, else existing unload_ollama_model() unchanged. [§20 item 5 stop-half]

Frontend decision (Human, this cycle): frontend is V3, NOT in V1B. Verified routers/bridge.py uses SELECT * for bridge_roles + bridge_flow_steps fetches (ll. 253/356/374/437/451/489/605) → new columns auto-surface in API JSON, no app.py change needed. WebUI Roles/Steps editor won't show/set model_source until V3 (dropdown + alias picker + validation cards). V1B pilot configured via SQL (Step C1) — consistent. Option (A) chosen: keep V1B backend-only.

3 phases: A (model-allocator: imple01-local alias + OpenCode adapter + run/start/stop + scripts/model-allocator PATH wrapper + tests), B (Father: DB backup + migration 003_model_allocator_fields.sql [4 nullable cols: bridge_roles.default_model_source/default_model_alias, bridge_flow_steps.model_source/model_alias] via python3 scripts/migrate.py NOT init_db.py + bridge_lib.get_effective_model_source() helper [step>role>system priority, inherit_from_role only valid on steps]), C (Father: pilot UPDATE on imple01 + start_coding.py conditional allocator-branch + dispatch.py conditional allocator-stop + final verification).

Validation is dry-run/unit-level (no live strict_review cycle during V1B); live validation Human-triggered after commit. Forbidden in V1B: Claude Code adapter (V2), llama.cpp/cloud/minimax backends (V2), unload/preflight/env/render-config commands (V2), UI/frontend (V3), command_builder.py changes, any role other than imple01 configured with model_allocator.

Handoff file: /home/svend/flows/cloud_pay/handoffs/66-handoff.md. Targets both /home/svend/model-allocator + /home/svend/DPMtF-WebUI (Father).
